name: io.github.tonyyang0504/dreamship-mcp
description: Dreamship (ecommerce suppliers): me, list_products, get_product, create_order, get_order. Every tool

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_DREAMSHIP_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Dreamship API key from Settings (https://dreamship.com/app/settings), sent as `Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>`.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_DREAMSHIP_TEST_ORDER
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to send `test_order: true` on create_order (test orders are not billed or fulfilled); left out of the body when unset, so orders are real.
